summary: Stantec Inc. filed a Form 6-K (Material Change Report) announcing CEO succession. Gordon A. Johnston will retire as president and CEO effective October 1, 2026, and remain as vice chair of the board. Susan Reisbord, currently North America COO and former CEO of Cardno Inc., will become president and CEO on the same date, also joining the board. The transition results from a board-led succession plan, emphasizing leadership continuity. No financial terms, advisor, or tender involved. What to watch: smooth handover and strategic direction under new leadership.
